name: Tomosaka Sayuri
source:
An [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okonomiyaki]okonomiyaki[/url] stand clerk. Sayuri's cooking skills are so poor that sometimes her cuisine proves to be lethal. It is a mystery why she is still working at the stand at all. Due to this, Sayuri is "Part 1" of the stand manager Ruka's headache. (The second part of Ruka's headache is Sora)
